intro: Norse myth gets the short-drama treatment: a disgraced prince working in the stables turns out to be the only mortal who can lift Mjolnir. From there it is rebellion against Asgard itself, with frost giants, Valkyries and Odin all coming for him. Big, mythic and unapologetically epic.
why: A fallen-prince story with a satisfying rise from stable hand to god-level threat.
Norse mythology, runes and Mjolnir instead of the usual palace or office setting.
A partner in rebellion, Freydis, who fights alongside him rather than waiting to be saved.
Good pick if you like mythic fantasy and heroes who defy the ones in power.
